decisions.reason: Net price display remains a simple, useful B2B shop feature that can be maintained or ported to newer shop versions at low cost, though its absence from the website since 2020 raises doubt.
The ERP interface supports the multichannel strategy and ties clients to the firm, so it is worth maintaining even if it is less visible on the website.
Price comparison tracking still supports measurable marketing results, so this one stays as the consolidated version of the overlapping tracking plugins.
It overlaps with C, it has not appeared on the website since 2020, and shop platform migrations make keeping several similar tracking plugins hard to justify, so it should be consolidated.
Net price reporting complements the display plugin for B2B clients and needs few resources, though low visibility puts it at risk of being folded into A.
